terms.IBA: Inferred from Biological aspect of Ancestor: a phylogenetically inferred GO annotation, not biological aggregation.
terms.ISS: Inferred from Sequence or structural Similarity.
terms.PIP: Posterior inclusion probability under the recorded fine-mapping model; not effect size or proof that a variant is causal.
terms.PP.H4: Posterior support for a shared association signal under the recorded colocalization model; not proof of a biological mechanism.
terms.NES: Normalized enrichment score for the recorded ranked analysis. Direction requires its ranking contrast; it does not establish activation of every pathway gene.

sources.interpretation: Pinned BIM bundle; actual recorded measurements and context take precedence.
